en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy open-air café with many small round tables lined along both sides of a cobbled street. Numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or sit at the tables. The buildings are multi‑story with balconies and signs, and there is construction scaffolding and stacked lumber on the right. In the distance appears an open square with a monument or fountain. French text at the top identifies the scene as a souvenir from Salonique and the Place de la Liberté.
